title: Identify a European compact animation loop
changes: Record the conditional selector loop and bounded source projection for compact OBJ root 0x6ca5f8 as a candidate for later extraction and runtime consumption.
validation: Wine source query authenticated the original 0..2 loop, constructor call and 174-byte nonoverlapping source projection; three sequences contain 37 frames and nine lists contain eight objects, including one empty list. Prior constructor preservation evidence was reused.
limitations: Source analysis only; extraction, runtime consumption, ordinary reachability, other producers, Linux, USA and native Windows remain open. No performance or space measurements.
